base_protocol.arrival_model: independent Poisson arrivals per second; common tape across budgets
base_protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames; released jobs only; FIFO within class
base_protocol.score: queue weighted actual frame departures divided by actual frame duration
base_protocol.budget_unit: candidate construction or feasibility attempt; seeds included
base_protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at horizon, then drain the same finite prefix

protocol.eligibility: S(a) >= max(S_seed, (1-r)*S_inc); S_inc is the same paid pool's best support
protocol.cap_rationale: 1% is a fixed conservative design choice, not a fitted or optimal parameter
protocol.zero_cap_control: preserves paid incumbent support while allowing holding-cost changes among ties
protocol.arrival_rate_input: Lambda=sum(registered class arrival rates); fixed throughout arrival window and drain
protocol.drain_cost_interpretation: stationary-arrival proxy, not actual conditional arrivals after the cutoff
protocol.candidate_generation: same budgeted construction, order and max-support pruning as frozen v4
protocol.reference: frozen v4 K120; both cap policies retain their own selected support gap
protocol.prior_seed_only_comparison: reuse the previous 36 seed-only runs; do not rerun or overwrite them
protocol.stopping_rule: run all 108 cases once; no cap relaxation, grid search or budget selection after results

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

certificates.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificates.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

limitations: The relative cap concerns only the paid support incumbent, not full-space support or mean flow.
The selected certificate satisfies U-S_selected <= (U-S_inc)+r*S_inc; the seed guarantee still holds.
The support floor can increase with candidate budget, so holding cost need not decrease with budget.
The holding objective is myopic and optimized only on the paid pool; Lambda remains a stationary proxy during drain.
Execution PASS does not mean performance improvement; results use reused development seeds and deterministic cached durations.
Wall time is descriptive local timing; extra cost evaluations and offset reads are reported separately from candidate attempts.
